text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion delivered a stunning 
performance in the Oka Sho. She returns 
bursting with excitement.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The way she enjoyed herself with all her 
might was so dazzling that even the 
Umamusume trembling with pre-race nerves 
couldn't help but stare.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Next, she advances to the second leg of 
the Triple Tiara route: The Yushun Himba 
(Oaks)...!
